# CMake project for the C++ bindings of nova-ta generated by uniffi-bindgen-cpp.
# Layout produced by `cargo xtask build -t cpp`:
#   src/nova_ta.hpp, src/nova_ta.cpp, src/nova_ta_scaffolding.hpp   (generated, C++20)
#   lib/<native library> (+ nova_ta.dll.lib import library on Windows)
# The version is kept in sync with Cargo.toml by `cargo xtask check` / `cargo xtask bump`.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(nova_ta VERSION 0.1.2 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

add_library(nova_ta_ffi SHARED IMPORTED GLOBAL)
if(WIN32)
    set_target_properties(nova_ta_ffi PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/nova_ta.dll"
        IMPORTED_IMPLIB   "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/nova_ta.dll.lib")
elseif(APPLE)
    set_target_properties(nova_ta_ffi PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/libnova_ta.dylib")
else()
    set_target_properties(nova_ta_ffi PROPERTIES
        IMPORTED_LOCATION "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/lib/libnova_ta.so")
endif()

add_library(nova_ta STATIC src/nova_ta.cpp)
target_include_directories(nova_ta PUBLIC src)
target_link_libraries(nova_ta PUBLIC nova_ta_ffi)
